title: Affiliate Referral Cookie Tracking and Attribution Engine
description: Affiliate referral tracking captures URL parameters (e.g. ?ref=CODE or ?aff=123) upon visitor entry, stores a secure, tamper-proof cookie with a configurable expiration window, and attributes subsequent checkout conversions to the referring affiliate.
rules: Detect referral parameters early in the WordPress lifecycle during the 'template_redirect' or 'init' hook.

Set tracking cookies with secure, httponly, and samesite (Lax/Strict) flags: setcookie( $name, $val, array( 'expires' => $expire, 'path' => COOKIEPATH, 'domain' => COOKIE_DOMAIN, 'secure' => is_ssl(), 'httponly' => true, 'samesite' => 'Lax' ) ).
Support configurable attribution models: 'First Touch' vs. 'Last Touch' attribution.
Track raw visits/clicks in an analytics table while respecting privacy (hash IP addresses with salt).
anti_patterns: Setting cookies after HTML output has started (causes 'headers already sent' warnings).
Storing sensitive affiliate data or raw customer PII inside client cookies.
Allowing unrestricted cookie expiration without operator configuration.

patterns.name: Referral Capture and Cookie Handler
patterns.description: Intercepts referral query parameters and sets HTTP-only cookie.

title: Affiliate Commission Ledger State Machine and Refund Reversal
description: Commission records must transition through a deterministic state machine (PENDING -> APPROVED -> PAYABLE -> PAID / REJECTED) to ensure financial integrity, prevent payouts on refunded orders, and enforce fraud rules.
rules: Record commissions in status 'PENDING' immediately upon successful order placement.
Transition commissions to 'APPROVED' after the store refund/grace window expires (e.g. 30 days).
Hook 'woocommerce_order_status_refunded' and 'woocommerce_order_refunded' to immediately mark pending or approved commissions as 'REJECTED' with reason 'ORDER_REFUNDED'.
Prevent self-referrals: check if the purchasing customer's user ID or billing email matches the affiliate's registered user ID or payout email.
anti_patterns: Directly paying out commissions on initial checkout without waiting for order settlement.
Failing to reverse or adjust commissions when an order is partially or fully refunded.
Allowing an affiliate to earn commissions by purchasing products with their own referral code.

patterns.name: Refund Reversal Handler
patterns.description: Automated cancellation of commissions on WooCommerce order refund.

patterns.name: Self-Referral Prevention Guard
patterns.description: Verifying that the customer is not the affiliate owner.
